name: The Pendant Guarden
source:
Can you unlock the secrets of the crypts you have been seeking? Will those you encounter be trusted souls on the journey? See how your choices lead to your reward or ruin.

[Edited from [url=https://kipursuit.itch.io/the-pendant-guarden]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你能解开你一直在寻找的地穴的秘密吗？旅途中遇到的人会是值得信赖的灵魂吗？看看你的选择如何导致你的回报或毁灭。

[编辑自[url=https://kipursuit.itch.io/the-pendant-guarden]itch.io[/url]]
